title: Breakwave Bi-Weekly Tanker Report - October 20, 2026
summary:
Main
• VLCC Supported at Record High Amid Exceptional Geopolitical Risks - Continued attacks on shipping and energy infrastructure are keeping transportation costs exceptionally high . The reported Houthi strike on Saudi Aramco's Dhahran headquarters added to concerns over regional energy security, while recent tanker incidents in the Gulf underline the persistent threats to maritime operations. At their October 12 meeting, OPEC+ ministers warned that shipping and insurance costs have now risen above one-third of commodity value, highlighting the growing burden on international oil trade.
